scientific_question: Did the gated Hindsight wheelhouse acquisition produce exactly the independently verifiable, source-routed Linux CPython 3.11 artifacts frozen by the accepted lock?
decision_informed: Whether the wheelhouse is eligible to become the sole package source for a later isolated offline environment installation.
scientific_evidence_role: Read-only dependency-integrity audit design only; no download, installation, import, model, service, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim is eligible.

prior_gate.required_future_status: The materialization root must first be independently observed as terminal with an exact immutable wheelhouse-materialization.json SHA-256.

checks: the materialization record hash supplied by a successor prefreeze is exact and its terminal sentinels agree
every materialization evidence-inventory entry rehashes successfully
all 199 wheels have CPython 3.11/Linux-compatible tags and unique routed normalized distribution names
every version satisfies the active marker-evaluated locked requirement and every wheel digest occurs in that requirement's allowed SHA-256 set
every wheel path, route, distribution, version, byte size, and digest equals the materialization record
both download commands used exactly one frozen index, required hashes, binary-only mode, no dependency resolution, zero retry, and no extra index

authorization_gate: This design cannot execute because the wheelhouse materialization has not run. After Wave 1 terminal acceptance releases the resource gate, execute the existing wheelhouse prefreeze once; then create a separate audit-execution prefreeze binding the observed materialization record SHA-256, terminal state, fresh audit root, process count, and storage headroom.
acceptance: The successor audit exits zero, writes TERMINAL_ACCEPTED without TERMINAL_REJECTED, and independently validates all fixed identities, routed requirements, wheel artifacts, commands, and evidence rows without network access or mutation.
failure: Any missing, extra, duplicate, incompatible, wrong-route, wrong-version, unlisted-hash, altered-record, altered-evidence, retry, extra-index, or collision condition seals the fresh audit root TERMINAL_REJECTED; the wheelhouse and materialization root remain unchanged and retained.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Freeze a project-owned Python 3.11 environment materialization that installs only from the accepted wheelhouse with --no-index, followed by an independent package/import audit.
prohibited_actions: executing this design without a successor prefreeze containing the exact observed materialization record hash
accessing any package index or installing a dependency during audit
changing or deleting a wheel, lock route, materialization record, evidence row, or failed audit root
treating a successful download process as independent acceptance
populating a comparison-table numeric cell or making a superiority/SOTA claim
